'''DecipherCon 1999 No Such Thing As Luck''' was a Star Wars CCG side event at [[DecipherCon 1999]] (11–14 November 1999, Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia). [[Stephen Turner|Steven Turner]] won, out of 18 players over 4 games.<ref name="dc99sw12_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW12_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: No Such Thing As Luck], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001031231735/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW12_1.html Internet Archive]</ref>
